request.purpose: Before we place temporary workers we want to know which age groups carry this disease, so we can offer those groups only short-term contracts.
request.question: How many patients had an inpatient stay whose main diagnosis was diabetes in 2023 or later, by region?
definitions: Diabetes stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with E11.
Report per region: patients with at least one diabetes stay.
